sources.title: CivArchive - CivitAI Archive
sources.snippet: CivArchive is a cross-platform search engine for AI models. We don't host files ourselves — instead, we crawl various sources and index the models we find, using the file's SHA256 hash as its unique, permanent ID. CivArchive was created in direct response to models being suddenly removed from CivitAI. Our core mission is to be a resilient, community-driven archive that preserves access to ...

sources.title: OpenModelDB
sources.snippet: OpenModelDB is a community driven database of AI Upscaling models. We aim to provide a better way to find and compare models than existing sources.
